patch_description: Crossover combining the current program's stronger greedy assignment (choose the GPU minimizing KVPR *after* placement, which scored 24.81 vs 24.60) with the inspiration program's broader local search: it tries moves and swaps among *all* GPU pairs (not only off the worst GPU), uses index-tagged tuples to be safe with duplicate models, and re-simulates the full max KVPR per candidate move. This wider neighborhood search refines the better initial solution further.
